meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把解析好的文档和你的意图转成四张卡片：蓝色事实卡（附来源）、绿色解释卡、黄色风险卡、红色行动卡，每张卡都可溯源留痕。
howto.when: 当你手上有解析产出的结构化文档并需要分析输出时触发；主调用由通政司 Worker 发起，黄卡交监察院复核、红卡交丞相府补全。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这份文档
只出蓝卡，并标注每条事实的来源

say.note: 黄卡经监察院复核，红卡经丞相府补全

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a parsed document plus your intent into four cards: a blue fact card with sources, a green explanation card, a yellow risk card and a red action card. Each card is traceable and logged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a parsed, structured document and need analysis output. The Tongzhengsi worker calls it; the Jianchayuan reviews the yellow card and the Chengxiangfu fills in the red card.

say_en.text: Analyze this document with four-color cards
say_en.note: Outputs blue, green, yellow and red cards

say_en.text: Only produce the blue fact card, citing every source
say_en.note: Missing sources are marked as unsourced

say_en.text: Generate the risk and action cards
say_en.note: Yellow is reviewed; red gets strategy added
